findings.text: blocking: the split-interval ramp now fires for any table whose final secant is far below 1/mu0, and with fraction = average/(2*(left+right)) its two ramps carry half the interval's H increment, so the plateau slope falls to about three quarters of the secant and the whole final interval is distorted rather than only the join; a pinned base/head probe on the valid two-knot table [0,10], mu=[1000,1000] reads H(B) exactly linear at f63aa85d (deviation 4.6e-14) and 22.9% to 25.0% below it at 77b424b3 over 0.03-5 T, and two in-repo call sites pass that simple table shape.

non-blocking: the script and scripts/magnetisation_high_permeability/directional.py:55 still pass two-knot [0, 10] tables with mu in {100,300,1000,3000}, so they now measure the distorted law above and the numbers published in docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-high-permeability-shell.html no longer describe this module's output; both sites need the interior knot the node added to its own analytic controls.

non-blocking: left_edge and right_edge are differences of breakpoint coordinates, so a ramp narrower than one unit in the last place of b[i] makes them zero and divides zero by zero in the two quadratic coefficients, where the previous code divided by the product edge; _fit_law validates only secant > 0, so nothing refuses such a table.

non-blocking: the plan's section 4 still states the law "holds its end values outside the table", which the lead's 2026-11-11 ruling and this change replace with the vacuum-slope continuation; the plan edit belongs to the coordinator, not to this node's fence.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base f63aa85d; two implementation commits change 36 lines of _fit_law/_coefficient and 81 lines of tests, the last two are docs-only, and the base..head range also carries 36 peer files brought in by merge b56789ef4, which the node did not author.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's three clauses are asserted by tests/test_magnetisation.py:313-360 (constant M over [B_n,100 T], dH/dB = 1/mu0 past and at the join, every knot reproduced, on the manifest-guarded WEST table plus two synthetic tables) and recorded in baseline-suite.log and after-combined-suite.log with a negative control in negative-control.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to continue the B-H law past the last table knot with dH/dB = mu0 so M is bounded; nova/biot/magnetisation.py:156 sets the final fitted slope to 1/_MU0 and nova/biot/magnetisation.py:202 returns the constant-tail coefficient M_n/B, which is that goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete with four commits, baseline f63aa85d 20 passed 1 xfailed EXIT=0, after b56789ef 23 passed 1 xfailed EXIT=0, zero added failures, and the endpoint-hold mutant at 3 failed EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four node commits 34f109aa7, 00606c8c2, fe6f1eb11 and 77b424b3c touch only nova/biot/magnetisation.py, tests/test_magnetisation.py and docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-law-saturation-tail.html, all inside the declared paths; the declared docs/figures path is unused.

justifications.durability: tests/test_magnetisation.py:336 and :344 compare code output against M_n and 1/mu0 derived from the table rather than a value the test passed in, and negative-control.log reddens those three cases, but the analytic controls were moved to the three-knot table [0,1,10] so the distorted final interval is never sampled.
justifications.evidence: baseline-suite.log and after-combined-suite.log each carry a revision header, an import_assertion line and a bare EXIT= line (0 and 0), and negative-control.log carries EXIT=1 with the three saturation tests named.
justifications.fit: nova/biot/magnetisation.py:127-131 updates the module's own docstring to the mechanism, ruff reports no finding on either changed file, and no added name carries a plan label or an attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/biot/magnetisation.py:156 and :202 give H = H_n + (B-B_n)/mu0 past the knot and c = M_n/B, so M stays at M_n for every B >= B_n as the goal states.
justifications.reuse: no definition is added; _fit_law and _coefficient are extended in place, though scripts/prototypes/iron_magnetisation/magnetisation.py:154 keeps a second, now-divergent material law that the change does not reconcile.
justifications.scope_discipline: the four node commits touch exactly the three declared source, test and evidence paths, while merge b56789ef4 pulls 36 unrelated peer files into the base..head range.
